entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Lluamen pora toachigan
 Choma curi guhen, Cuma pe chori tupana tacufa choun cu na goen iima na cha cuhan fi ná cugo na charí inin.
 Ehobiñ na curi guhen domar gunengo chori tura y curi pora, chori tahouna curi guhimac.
 Tauma a nay a tupana, curin poraqui, toin ri gubenqui fiima chienfã, fiima por aqi nichataban.
